title: Azure AI Services: Vision, Language, and Speech
description: Use Azure AI Vision, Language, and Speech services to analyze images, process text, and transcribe audio.

data.text: Azure AI Vision, Language, and Speech services provide pre-built AI capabilities that you can add to your applications without training custom models. They are ideal for common tasks like image analysis, text translation, and speech transcription.
Azure AI Vision can analyze images to extract objects, text (OCR), descriptions, tags, and adult content scores. It also provides face detection (without recognition) and thumbnail generation.

data.title: C# - Analyze an Image with Azure AI Vision
data.content: Analyze an image and extract tags and description.

data.text: Azure AI Language provides text analysis capabilities including sentiment analysis, key phrase extraction, entity recognition, language detection, and text translation across 100+ languages.

data.title: C# - Translate Text with Azure AI Translation
data.content: Translate text from English to French.

data.text: Azure AI Speech provides speech-to-text (transcription), text-to-speech (synthesis), speech translation, and speaker recognition. It supports real-time streaming for live transcription and batch processing for recorded audio.

terms.definition: Optical Character Recognition - the process of extracting text from images or scanned documents.
A Language service feature that classifies text as positive, negative, or neutral, with confidence scores.
Converts written text into natural-sounding speech. Azure supports multiple voices, languages, and speaking styles.
Converts spoken audio into text. Supports real-time streaming and batch transcription.

data.title: Single Multi-Service Resource
data.text: You can use a single Azure AI Services multi-service resource for Vision, Language, and Speech. This simplifies key management for development. Use individual resources in production for cost tracking and access control.

data.title: Exercise: Build a Multi-Modal AI App
data.description: Combine Vision, Language, and Speech services in one application.
steps: Use Azure AI Vision to analyze an image and extract tags
Use Azure AI Language to analyze the sentiment of a review
Use Azure AI Speech to convert a text string to speech (save to audio file)
Display all results in the console
Deploy the app and test with different inputs
data.expectedOutcome: A console app that demonstrates image analysis, text sentiment, and text-to-speech.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Azure AI Vision analyzes images for objects, text, and descriptions
Azure AI Language processes text for sentiment, entities, and translation
Azure AI Speech converts between audio and text
All three services can share a multi-service resource for development
data.takeaway: Vision, Language, and Speech services let you add multimodal AI to your app without training any models.
